about: Parking permit for residents of flats and villas in Abu Dhabi.
note: Requirements read from the official Abu Dhabi Mobility page on the checked date. This service has no sign-in form of its own to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: Owners or tenants of the home and their first and second degree relatives living there
UAE nationals: up to 4 permits for flats; villas as set by the inspector's report
Non-UAE nationals: 2 permits, more subject to the inspector's report
